cli_surface: setup (auth bucket capture-otlp claude-code codex-cli git llm-review pi privacy-filter skill trufflehog upgrade watcher)
trace (query map slice get index teleport compare discover)
ctx (tree show step reads writes diff compactions prune resume resolve anchor-for-step list info)
bucket (status manifest verify repair rebuild prune prefetch replay remote)
dataset (new run review publish remote schedule status list remove)
workflow (create list templates remove optimize skill-intelligence verifier-factory)
invariants: Event log ref refs/opentraces/local/events/v1 append-only; anchor exact-hash then structural-0.85; security order regex,entropy,trufflehog,privacy_filter,llm_pii,business_logic,path_anonymizer,capsule_scope,classifier (default OFF); gzip mtime=0 byte-identity; Trace Intelligence derive-on-demand.
schema_contracts: SCHEMA_VERSION=0.6.0 additive-only; Outcome.patch removed 0.6.0 for TraceRecord.patches; frozen envelopes bump-on-change.
must_not_break: Every VISIBLE + HIDDEN command stays callable (hooks run _run-post-commit-hook + _capture); trail blame stays a GROUP; event log ref, security order, schema additivity, three version numbers (CLI 0.4.0/schema 0.6.0/security 0.6.0) unchanged.
